purpose: Build the actual 0bp-added-slippage, Tiered-fee, own-state local recovery-versus-HOLD training label for the already qualified 10:31 signed-volume action feature. Do not relabel the existing 2bp source or fit a model in this card.
parent_boundary: Use the saved 2018-2022 full-history recovery card's 1061 OOF original-39-input allocation targets as the training reference. This is a training scaffold, not the frozen 2023+ f696 Stage1 held account. The future information screen must use the exact original Stage1 recovery receiver and the final economic account must use the complete frozen Stage1 parent.

account.open_controller: deterministic always-open risk-projected Stage1 OOF target
account.recovery_controller: none on the training reference path

local_label: At eligible 10:31 state, use actual beta cap min(raw_beta,0.6), original alpha floor, enter optional recovery at 10:32 versus HOLD from identical post-open raw quantities/cash; both branches pay Tiered fees and reset to the same next-session 09:47 reference target, with independent monthly fee counters. Label available only after next 09:49. Last unsupported reset stays unknown.
cost_scope: This is 0bp added slippage with Tiered fees still charged, not gross 0-fee return. The saved 2bp training_reference is a date/target comparison only; its state and net_advantage may not substitute for this new 0bp reference.
stop: One reference replay/native account and one label pass only. If model/source identity, 1061-date calendar, native raw quantities/cash/NAV, reference reset or label maturity fail, record exact failure and stop without relabeling 2bp evidence. No feature fit or held strategy account here.
